responsibility: This header defines the compact, tree-free data model for OpenMP context selectors used by declare variant and related trait matching. It owns the enums for trait set selectors, trait selectors, and property forms; the table-driven metadata structure describing each selector’s name, valid trait-set contexts, property kind, score allowance, and permitted property names; and the lookup interfaces that map parsed selector strings to internal codes. Its purpose is to let parsers and shared OpenMP utilities validate and classify selector syntax consistently, including from the Fortran front end, without depending on GCC tree internals.
